content.text: Vitamin
Vitamin B1 (Thiamine)
Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin)
Vitamin B3 (Niacin /Nicotinic Acid /Niacinamide)
RDA (Adults)
Whole blood thiamine: 70–180 nmol/L
RDA:       -    F: 1.1 mg/day                     -    M: 1.2 mg/day
Erythrocyte glutathione reductase activity coefficient (EGR-AC)
RDA:       -    F: 1.1 mg/day                             -    M: 1.3 mg/day
Serum niacin (nicotinamide): variable        UL: 35 mg/day (nicotinic acid: flushing threshold)
RDA:        -   F: 14 mg NE/day               -     M: 16 mg NE/day
Food Sources
Whole grains, enriched bread/cereals, fortified foods
Pork (richest animal source), Legumes, nuts, seeds
Dairy prod (milk, yogurt, cheese), eggs
Lean meats, organ meats (liver), Green veggies, fortified cereals
Meat, poultry, fish (tuna, salmon), Peanuts, nuts, legumes, whole grains, fortified cereals
Synth from tryptophan (60 mg Trp = 1 NE)
Absorption & Storage
- absorbed in jejunum: active transport= ↓doses, passive=↑doses
Min storage: body stores last 2–3 wk
-Phosphorylate -> B1-pyrophosphate (TPP): active coenzyme for carb metabol
- Rapidly depleted by high carb intake w.o adequate B1:
refeeding syndrome
- Absorbed in proximal sm intestine                     -  not stored sig
- Active forms: FMN & FAD: coenzymes in oxidation-red rxn
(e
transport chain, fatty acid oxidation)
- Sensitive to light: milk in transparent containers loses riboflavin
- Rapidly absorbed in GI tract                                                              - min storage
- Active forms: NAD+ & NADP+: central coenzymes
hundreds of redox rxns, energy prod, DNA repair
- Pharm doses for dyslipidemia: ↑HDL, ↓TG
Deficiency
Effects & Causes
-Dry Beriberi: periph neuropathy (glove & stocking), musc weak, wasting
- Wet Beriberi: high-output cardiac failure, cardiomegaly, edema, HF
- Wernicke Encephalopathy (Wernicke-Korsakoff): oculomotor dysfun
(nystagmus, ophthalmoplegia), ataxia, confusion -TRIAD
- Korsakoff -irreversible amnesia, confabulation if Wernicke ⍉tx
Cause: ETOH (MC in developed world), poor diet, malabsorb, prolonged parenteral nutrition w.o B1, hyperemesis gravidarum, refeeding syndrome
DEFICIENCY (ariboflavinosis):
-Angular cheilitis, cheilosis, glossitis (purplish tongue), pharyngitis
- Seborrheic dermatitis (nose, ears, genitalia)
- Corneal vasc, photophobia
- Normocytic anemia
Causes: dairy-free, poverty/poor diet, malabsorb, hypothyroid, ETOH, preg
DEFICIENCY (Pellagra) — the 4 Ds:
- Dermatitis: symmetric B/L, sun-exposed skin lesions (Casal's necklace)
- Diarrhea: enteritis, malabsorb
- Dementia/Delirium: cogn impairment, psychosis
- Death (if untx)
Causes: corn-based diets w.o lime tx (niacin in corn), ETOH, malabsorb (Crohn's, carcinoid syndrome-diverts tryptophan to 5-HT), Hartnup dz (tryptophan absorb defect), isoniazid tx
Toxicity (Excess)
Effects & Causes
- Very low toxicity: excess renally excreted
- Rare: HA, weakness, allergic rxn w lrg IV doses
- No established UL (no toxicity observed)
- Very low toxicity: excreted renally
- Urine turns bright yellow at higher doses (harmless)
- No established UL
-Nicotinic acid (⍉niacinamide): flush/itch/warm -prostaglandin-mediated: ASA pretx help
-↑glycemia, ↑uricemia (gout), ↓BP, blurred vision, Hepatotoxicity: esp w ↑dose ER
Causes: pharma niacin tx (1–3 g/day) for hyperlipidemia
Supp Commonly Needed?
YES: alcoholic (supp b4 IV glucose -> prevent Wernicke encephalopathy), hsp/malnourished pt, bariatric surgery pt, parenteral nutrition
Rare; Yes: avoid dairy/meat, preg (↑demand), migraine prophylaxis (400 mg/day)
Rare; Some: dyslipidemia (less common w statins)
yes: pellagra tx, malabsorb, isoniazid-treated pt
Uses
MOA: necessary coenzyme (thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP)) for key
enzymes in glucose & AA breakdown  -carb & lipids (food -> E)
- necessary components for n. signal transmission & n. health
support memory, focus, & overall brain health
- Support proper ♡vasc function              -
vital for cell growth & function
MOA: precursor to coenzymes FAD & FMN ->e
carriers in redox rxn
- convert carb/fat/protein -> ATP   *help cells develop & function
-     metabolize fats, drugs, steroids
antioxidant: ↓oxidative stress & protect against free radical damage
- maintain RBC, Fe absorb, GI tract & NS, protect eyes, ⍉cataracts
- High-dose riboflavin partial ↓freq & duration of migraines
MOA: Niacin (NAD & NADP): coenzyme precursor, convert carb/fat/protein -> E &
DNA repair & cell signaling
- ↑doses: inhibit lipolysis via inhibit liver diacylglycerol acyltransferase-2 in adipose
tissue & ↓TG synth in liver -> ↓VLDL/LDL & ↑HDL
- protect brain cells; maintain skin -nicotinamide poss ↓nonmelanoma skin CA risk
- tx pellagra (niacin deficiency); poss help osteoarthritis, NAFLD, T1DM risk.
